fix(hermes): deliver long Concord replies as file before summary text

Group long replies previously sent a native quote reply first, which often
timed out at the Pilot UI layer and prevented the Markdown attachment from
ever being sent. Send attachments first, skip quote replies for long
documents, and extend the Harbor confirmation window via
CONCORD_DELIVERY_WAIT_SECONDS.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
